title: Shaass and Bookshelf
statementMd:
Shaass has $*n*$ books. He wants to make a bookshelf for all his books. He wants the bookshelf's dimensions to be as small as possible. The thickness of the $*i*$-th book is $*t*_{*i*}$ and its pages' width is equal to $*w*_{*i*}$. The thickness of each book is either $1$ or $2$. All books have the same page heights.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a0717a4d638e90b96d21956ba5c63ca11ab4694d.png)

Shaass puts the books on the bookshelf in the following way. First he selects some of the books and put them vertically. Then he puts the rest of the books horizontally above the vertical books. The sum of the widths of the horizontal books must be no more than the total thickness of the vertical books. A sample arrangement of the books is depicted in the figure.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e4df5ef6413006729dc788d02b6e321e4a23b590.png)

Help Shaass to find the minimum total thickness of the vertical books that we can achieve.

## Input

The first line of the input contains an integer $*n*$, $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100)$. Each of the next $*n*$ lines contains two integers $*t*_{*i*}$ and $*w*_{*i*}$ denoting the thickness and width of the $*i*$-th book correspondingly, ($1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 2, 1 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 100$).

## Output

On the only line of the output print the minimum total thickness of the vertical books that we can achieve.
statementZhMd:
Shaass 有 $*n*$ 本书。他想为所有书制作一个书架，并希望书架的尺寸尽可能小。第 $*i*$ 本书的厚度为 $*t*_{*i*}$，书页的宽度为 $*w*_{*i*}$。每本书的厚度都为 $1$ 或 $2$。所有书的书页高度都相同。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a0717a4d638e90b96d21956ba5c63ca11ab4694d.png)

Shaass 按照以下方式将书放在书架上。首先，他选出其中一些书并将它们竖直放置。然后，他将剩下的书水平放置在竖直放置的书上方。水平放置的书的宽度之和不得超过竖直放置的书的总厚度。下图展示了一种书籍摆放方式。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e4df5ef6413006729dc788d02b6e321e4a23b590.png)

请帮助 Shaass 求出能够达到的竖直放置书籍的最小总厚度。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$，$(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100)$。接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*t*_{*i*}$ 和 $*w*_{*i*}$，分别表示第 $*i*$ 本书的厚度和宽度，$(1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 2, 1 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 100)$。

## 输出格式

输出一行，表示能够达到的竖直放置书籍的最小总厚度。
